ToggleButton.name: label
ToggleButton.description: Accessible name and tooltip; the button usually shows only an icon.

Calendar.name: min
Calendar.description: Days before `min` or after `max` can't be picked.

FileUploader.name: accept
FileUploader.description: Same format as the native accept attribute: ".pdf,.png,image/*".

FileUploader.name: maxSize
FileUploader.description: Largest allowed file in bytes. Bigger files are listed with an error and not passed to onFilesAdded.

FileUploader.name: name
FileUploader.description: Sends the valid files with a plain form submit (multipart/form-data).

FileUploader.name: value
FileUploader.description: The listed files. Update an item's status / progress / error as your upload runs.

FileUploader.name: onFilesAdded
FileUploader.description: The files that passed the checks, each time the user adds some. Start your uploads here.

TextInput.name: invalid
TextInput.description: Error text. Shows the field in its error state.

PasswordInput.name: invalid
PasswordInput.description: Error text. Shows the field in its error state.

TextArea.name: maxCount
TextArea.description: Shows a "12/300" counter and limits the length.

NumberInput.name: value
NumberInput.description: null when the field is empty.

Search.name: onSearch
Search.description: Called when the user presses Enter.

Search.name: expandable
Search.description: Starts as an icon button and opens on click.

Select.name: placeholder
Select.description: Shown while nothing is chosen; the user can't pick it again.

Dropdown.name: name
Dropdown.description: Adds a hidden input so the value is sent with a plain form submit.

ComboBox.name: onInputChange
ComboBox.description: Called as the user types, for example to load options from a server.

ComboBox.name: filter
ComboBox.description: Set to false when you filter `options` yourself (for example on the server).

ComboBox.name: name
ComboBox.description: Adds a hidden input so the value is sent with a plain form submit.

MultiSelect.name: name
MultiSelect.description: Adds a hidden input so the value is sent with a plain form submit.

Toggle.name: name
Toggle.description: Sends `value` with the form while the switch is on, like a checkbox.

DatePicker.name: name
DatePicker.description: Adds a hidden input with the date as yyyy-mm-dd.

DatePicker.name: formatDate
DatePicker.description: How the chosen date is shown. Defaults to dd/mm/yyyy.

TimePicker.name: value
TimePicker.description: 24-hour "HH:mm", or null when empty or not valid yet.

TimePicker.name: hour12
TimePicker.description: Show hh:mm with AM / PM (default) or a 24-hour clock. The value is always 24-hour.

TimePicker.name: name
TimePicker.description: Adds a hidden input with the 24-hour value.

TimePicker.name: timeZones
TimePicker.description: Shows a time-zone select when given.

InputOTP.name: onComplete
InputOTP.description: Called once every digit is filled in.

InputOTP.name: name
InputOTP.description: Adds a hidden input with the code.

Notification.name: actionText
Notification.description: Label of the action button. Shown together with onAction.

Notification.name: timestamp
Notification.description: Toasts: when it happened, for example "09:30".

Modal.name: onPrimaryClick
Modal.description: The primary button. Close the modal yourself when the work is done. Without it, the button just closes.

Modal.name: onSecondaryClick
Modal.description: The secondary button. The modal closes afterwards.

Modal.name: primaryLoading
Modal.description: Shows a spinner on the primary button and disables both buttons.

Modal.name: formId
Modal.description: Makes the primary button submit this form (the id of a <form> inside or outside the modal).

Modal.name: footer
Modal.description: Replace the footer, or pass null for none.

ProgressBar.name: value
ProgressBar.description: Leave out for an indeterminate bar.

ProgressIndicator.name: steps
ProgressIndicator.type: readonly { label: ReactNode; note?: ReactNode; invalid?: boolean; }[]

Tag.name: dismissLabel
Tag.description: Name for the dismiss button when children isn't plain text.

Tag.name: selected
Tag.description: Makes the tag a toggle button (filter chip).

DataTable.name: getRowId
DataTable.description: A stable id per row. Defaults to row.id, then the row's index.

DataTable.name: label
DataTable.description: Accessible name when there is no title.

DataTable.name: batchActions
DataTable.description: Buttons shown in the toolbar while rows are selected. Plain <button>s get the toolbar styling.

DataTable.name: filterable
DataTable.description: Shows the filter box. Defaults to true.

DataTable.name: manual
DataTable.description:
Leave filtering and sorting to you, for example on the server: the table
shows `data` as given and only reports filter / sort changes.

DataTable.name: toolbar
DataTable.description: Extra controls at the end of the toolbar, such as an Export or Add button.

DataTable.name: loading
DataTable.description: Shows placeholder rows while data loads.

DataTable.name: emptyState
DataTable.description: Shown when there are no rows and no filter is set.

StructuredList.name: selectable
StructuredList.description: Lets the user pick one row, like a radio group.

StructuredList.name: name
StructuredList.description: Radio name, so the chosen row id is sent with a form.

ContainedList.name: onRemove
ContainedList.description: Shows a remove button on each row. Remove the item from `items` in here.

TreeView.name: expanded
TreeView.description: Ids of open folders. A node's id is its `id`, or its labels joined with "/".

Tile.name: onClick
Tile.description: clickable: renders a button when there is no href.

Tile.name: children
Tile.description: expandable: the content shown when open.

Accordion.name: multiple
Accordion.description: Allow more than one open item. Defaults to true.

Attachment.name: progress
Attachment.description: 0–100. Shows a progress bar until it reaches 100.

BarChart.name: categoryKey
BarChart.description: The field holding each bar group's label (the x axis).

BarChart.name: description
BarChart.description: A line under the label, such as the date range.

Message.name: text
Message.description: Text the copy button copies. Defaults to children when they are plain text; without either, there is no copy button.

Message.name: footer
Message.description: Shows the copy / helpful buttons under messages from others.

Trace.name: summary
Trace.description: The header text. Defaults to "Checked 2 of 4 steps".

Menubar.name: menus
Menubar.type: readonly { label: string; items: readonly MenuItem[]; }[]

Command.name: groups
Command.type: readonly { heading: string; items: readonly CommandItem[]; }[]

UIShell.name: homeHref
UIShell.description: Where the product name links to.

UIShell.name: actions
UIShell.description: Buttons at the end of the header, for example <UIShellAction>.

UIShell.name: activeItem
UIShell.description: Id of the current side-nav item.

AlertDialog.name: onAction
AlertDialog.description:
Runs when the action button is pressed. The dialog closes afterwards. If it
returns a promise, the buttons wait for it, and the dialog stays open if it rejects.

AlertDialog.name: onCancel
AlertDialog.description: Runs when the user cancels (button, Escape). The dialog closes either way.

Collapsible.name: children
Collapsible.description: The part that opens and closes.

Collapsible.name: preview
Collapsible.description: Always visible, above the part that opens.

Resizable.name: size
Resizable.description: Width of the start panel, in percent.
